chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Al-Reza (peace be upon him), who said:

My father (peace be upon him), whenever he exited from his house, would say: 'In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. I go out with the Might of Allah and His Strength, not by my might and my strength, but with Your Might and Your Strength. O Lord! I expose myself to Your sustenance, therefore bring it to me in well-being.'
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for leaving the house in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication highlights the Imam's practice of explicitly renouncing personal agency ('la bi-hawlin minni') to affirm total dependence on God's power for sustenance. It serves as a practical model for integrating spiritual mindfulness into daily routines, linking physical departure with a request for health and provision.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It was so that whenever my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> went out from his<sup>asws</sup> house, said: ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Beneficent, the Merciful. I<sup>asws</sup> go out with the Might of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Strength, not by my<sup>asws</sup> might and my<sup>asws</sup> strength, but with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Strength. O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> am exposing myself<sup>asws</sup> to Your<sup>azwj</sup> sustenance, therefore Give it to me in good health’’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Rida (a.s.) who has said the following: “

My father when coming out of his house would say, ‘(I begin) in the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. I have come out by means and power of Allah and not by my own means and power, but, O Lord, by Your power and means, in search for sustenance from You, so grant me sustenance in good health.’”
